THE EMPIRICAL GROUND-TRUTH DIFFERENCE
Remote spectroscopy guesses habitability from light-years away. Sealing the cabin and deploying autonomous droids for physical ground truth delivers verifiable science.
DISCLOSURE: SPECULATIVE 0.1c INTERSTELLAR PROPULSION

Chemical and electric propulsion, as well as solar-sail deployment, have been demonstrated in space. However, no demonstrated propulsion system can accelerate a practical spacecraft to 0.1c. Crossing 101.5 light-years takes approximately 1,015 years in Earth's reference frame. It is an educational scenario, not human-lifetime travel.

DISCLOSURE: UNCONFIRMED EXOPLANET CONDITIONS & SIMULANTS

TESS transit photometry confirms TOI-700 e's radius (0.919 R⊕) and orbit in the optimistic habitable zone. However, its atmosphere, surface liquid water, and regolith chemistry are unconfirmed. Recovered water ice and soil canisters are candidate biosignature simulants.

"Stops 1 through 9 are real places. Harbor is TOI-700 e from the NASA Exoplanet Archive. The voyage past the heliopause uses the archive's numbers. The aliens and the droid are the story."
